 """py.test tests for addbook"""
+from unittest.mock import Mock, call
+
+import pytest
 import web
 from .. import addbook
 from openlibrary import accounts
 from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    'doc',
+    [
+        {'title': 'Untitled work'},
+        {'title': 'Untitled work', 'author_key': ['OL1A']},
+        {'title': 'Untitled work', 'author_name': ['An Author']},
+    ],
+)
+def test_make_work_without_complete_author_fields(doc):
+    web.ctx.site = Mock()
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert isinstance(work, web.Storage)
+    assert work == {
+        **doc,
+        'authors': [],
+        'cover_url': '/images/icons/avatar_book-sm.png',
+        'ia': [],
+        'first_publish_year': None,
+    }
+    web.ctx.site.new.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_make_work_creates_authors_and_preserves_metadata():
+    authors = [object(), object()]
+    web.ctx.site = Mock()
+    web.ctx.site.new.side_effect = authors
+    doc = {
+        'title': 'A work',
+        'author_key': ['OL1A', 'OL2A'],
+        'author_name': ['First Author', 'Second Author'],
+        'cover_url': '/covers/123-S.jpg',
+        'ia': ['identifier'],
+        'first_publish_year': 1900,
+    }
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert work == {**doc, 'authors': authors}
+    assert work.authors[0] is authors[0]
+    assert work.authors[1] is authors[1]
+    assert web.ctx.site.new.call_args_list == [
+        call(
+            '/authors/OL1A',
+            {'key': '/authors/OL1A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'First Author'},
+        ),
+        call(
+            '/authors/OL2A',
+            {'key': '/authors/OL2A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'Second Author'},
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
